title: StashProviderConnectedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'stash.provider.connected'. Stash OPEN ledger item 7 (Stash SQLite metadata sync): emitted by apps/worker/src/stash/connect.ts the first time a library's Stash connection succeeds after any non-'ok' status (never_connected, unreachable, or unsupported_schema) — the admin-visible counterpart to stash.provider.disabled, so the admin UI can flip a connection's status live instead of needing to reopen the Stash modal. TRANSITION-GATED, not written on every successful connect: connectToStashLibrary is called per-scene during ordinary metadata fetches (apps/worker/src/metadata/providers/stash.ts's fetchDetails), so an unconditional emit would flood the event feed with redundant events during a normal scan of an already-healthy library. envelope.actorUserId is always null (system-originated: a connect attempt has no human actor in the loop, same posture as stash.provider.disabled/probe.failed). ADMIN-ONLY delivery, same operational-event posture as stash.provider.disabled.

libraryId.description: The library whose library_stash_connections row this connect attempt was for.

schemaVersion.description: The Stash schema_migrations.version this connect attempt observed — mirrors library_stash_connections.last_seen_schema_version for the same connection.
